description: The file defines the HeaderData class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling report header data. It includes properties and methods for managing columns, groups, and counts used in report headers.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: A class managing header data for reports, including columns and group counts, within the OrangeHRM reporting module.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of columns used in the header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the array of columns used in the header.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of columns.

methods.name: setColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of columns.

methods.name: incrementColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the column count by a specified value, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: incrementGroupCount
methods.description: Increments the group count by a specified value, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the count of grouped columns.

methods.name: setGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Sets the count of grouped columns.

methods.name: incrementGroupedColumnCount
methods.description: Increments the count of grouped columns by a specified value, defaulting to 1.
